verdict.rationale: A government corporate registry could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only the Online Filing Centre, PDF forms and email notices. The probe states the registry 'documents no transactional API on any surface checked'. The keyless JSON endpoint it found belongs to the national open.canada.ca CKAN layer, a separate host platform that earns no credit here. No OpenAPI or equivalent spec download is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
